name: ai-char-engine
description: Interactive evidence-grounded persistent character engine for Codex image generation.

interface.shortDescription: Build and keep one visual character consistent.
interface.longDescription: An interactive Codex workflow that guides non-technical users from a new character or unlimited reference photos, builds an evidence-grounded identity brain with provenance and conflict handling, expands trusted views lazily, and generates consistent photorealistic images with bounded context and repair cost.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a new character from scratch.
I already have a character. Guide me through references.
Generate a new photo of my saved character.
